buildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');if(fs.existsSync('frontend')){cp.execSync('cd frontend && npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'});if(!fs.existsSync('dist')){fs.mkdirSync('dist');}fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','dist',{recursive:true});}else{cp.execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'});}"
